''Not to be confused with [[Quel'Danil Lodge]].''

[[Quel'Lithien Lodge]] is a [[high elven]] hunting lodge near the entrance to the ruined kingdom of [[Quel'Thalas]]. It is one of two major concentrations of high elves in [[Lordaeron]]. Quel'Lithien is home to [[Ranger Lord Hawkspear]], a silver elite [[Alliance]] NPC. It is also the home to the [[ranger]]s, [[pathstrider]]s, and [[woodsman|woodsmen]] that are the object of the quest [[The Ranger Lord's Behest]].
